executor_topology_compliance.rule: Each facet evidence has a unique reviewer_id for this change_id; small PRs use the single COMBINED reviewer exception.

consensus_points.headline: PR #1 was merged while the static ADR-0039 wiring gate reported FAILURE. That makes the initial verified API surface untrustworthy as a compliance baseline because the release evidence lane did not pass before merge.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Re-run the supply-chain/ADR-0039 lane on the current dev/staging/production SHA and file or fix any residual ADR-0039 wiring violations before treating PR #1 as a verified baseline.

consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Replay the ADR-0039/supply-chain and release-attestation lanes against the current baseline SHA, publish the exact pass/fail artifact next to the PR evidence, and mark any still-failing contract group as not verified until fixed.

consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Treat PR #1 as an unverified bootstrap until the current target SHA reruns the supply-chain and release-attestation checks successfully; make the baseline gate fail closed on any failed or skipped security sub-lane.

consensus_points.headline: Large contract surface landed before a per-endpoint/accounted inventory existed. Review cannot prove every endpoint/schema has an owner, data-class, auth posture, and generated binding.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Generate/validate endpoint and schema inventory from the current tree and register missing owner/data-class/auth rows as bounded FixupTasks.

consensus_points.headline: The PR advertises a verified API contract surface, but its own required supply-chain gate is red: statusCheckRollup reports `static ADR-0039 wiring gate` FAILURE. A bootstrap PR with a failing required control-plane check is not a shippable base; every later…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Fix the ADR-0039 evidence/script/registry contract until the required check passes, or remove the required check from branch protection until it is real. Do not merge a red foundation.

consensus_points.headline: Unrelated product prompt for a Windows Korean payroll MVP is committed at the repo root of a PR titled `Publish verified Oyatie API contract surface`. This is naming-that-lies and review-surface pollution: a reviewer cannot tell whether payroll prompt text is…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Delete it from this PR, or move it to a clearly scoped historical evidence/prompt archive with an owning plan reference. Do not ship unrelated prompt artifacts in the foundation/API surface.

consensus_points.headline: The bootstrap installs multiple overlapping local verification entry points (`scripts/check.sh`, `scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.sh`, and repoctl pre-push). That is control-plane sprawl before the repo even has a stable canonical path; later PRs had to…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Choose one canonical verifier now. Keep the shell shim only if it execs the canonical Rust command; delete parallel Python/shell gate bodies and repoctl hook paths from the bootstrap.

consensus_points.headline: 1070 files / 214,313 insertions land as one PR. This prevents meaningful review and mixes contracts, runtime crates, docs, CI, prompts, registry data, and governance in one blast radius. Linus rule: if a change cannot be understood as one simple story, split…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Split into mechanical bootstrap, contract set, runtime crate families, CI/gates, and governance/docs PRs. Each slice should have its own passing evidence and rollback boundary.

consensus_shifts_from_round_1_to_round_2: Final synthesis incorporates facet-specific reviewer evidence after the initial merged-PR inventory pass.
